what: Dither-quantised lighting motion comparison: protocol fixed before the first metric run
note: project-docs/DITHER-LIGHTING-PROTOCOL.md holds the prose, the model values and the decision rule

predictions.P2: L screen > world-fixed > world-octave on dolly, strafe, yaw; world-octave lowest on orbit

decision.score: mean over paths of max(L/Lmax, F/Fmax)
decision.source_tie_rule: if mean L and F differ < 10% relative between bayer8 and blue64, choose bayer8 on cost
